description: This file contains unit tests for the NextWordDictionary class in the com.anysoftkeyboard.nextword package, verifying its behavior in loading, resetting, and querying next words.

classes.name: NextWordDictionaryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for NextWordDictionary, testing its core functionalities such as loading, resetting, and retrieving next words.

methods.name: assertHasNextWordsForWord
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the next words for a given input match expected values, optionally notifying the dictionary of the typed word.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the NextWordDictionary instance before each test.

methods.name: testLoadEmpty
methods.description: Tests loading an empty dictionary and verifies that word counts are zero.

methods.name: testLyrics
methods.description: Tests the dictionary with a sequence of words, verifying next word predictions and counts.

methods.name: testResetSentence
methods.description: Verifies that resetting the sentence maintains the correct next word predictions.

methods.name: testLoadAgain
methods.description: Tests reloading the dictionary and verifies that the data persists correctly.

methods.name: testClearData
methods.description: Verifies that clearing data resets the dictionary's state.

methods.name: testDoesNotLearnIfNotNotifying
methods.description: Ensures that the dictionary does not learn new words unless explicitly notified.
